name: com.vngroundtruth/groundtruth
description: Vietnam trip feasibility with sources: visa, e-visa gates, boat bans, storm alerts, Tet, fines

tools.name: check_vietnam_trip
tools.description: Use when a user is planning or about to take a trip to Vietnam and you need to know whether it works as planned. Call it once, as the last step of itinerary planning, with nationality, dates and the places on the route. Returns one overall verdict plus flags for: visa exemption and stay length, whether the entry gate accepts e-visas, public holidays in the dates (Tet), recorded boat suspensions for Ha Long and the islands, official storm/flood bulletins (only when the trip is within 7 days), capped experiences (Son Doong) and motorbike licence rules (Ha Giang). Every item carries a source link and checked date. Does not search flights, hotels or tours.

nationality.description: Passport country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (DE) or English name

places.description: Places on the route, e.g. ["Ha Long", "Ha Giang", "Con Dao"]. Max 10.

entry_port.description: Airport, land border gate or sea port of entry, e.g. "Moc Bai" or "Noi Bai"

tools.name: check_entry
tools.description: Use when the question is only whether a passport holder needs a visa for Vietnam on a given arrival date. Returns status (visa_exempt, outside_validity_window, not_exempt_for_this_purpose, not_in_exemption_list), maximum stay in days, the legal basis, the validity window (many unilateral exemptions end in 2028), a tourism-only flag, the source and the official e-visa domains. For a whole itinerary use check_vietnam_trip instead.

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. DE) or English country name

tools.name: evisa_entry_ports
tools.description: Use when a traveller on a Vietnam e-visa needs to know whether a specific airport, land border crossing (from Cambodia, Laos or China) or sea port accepts e-visas, or wants the list of gates for one border. Returns listed / not_listed, the legal basis (Resolution 127/NQ-CP and 389/NQ-CP), and a flag for airports that apply only once they open. Call with no arguments for the full list of 83.

query.description: Gate or province name, accents optional, e.g. "Moc Bai", "Lao Bao", "Phu Quoc"

border_country.description: For land gates: Cambodia, Laos or China

tools.name: island_ferry_status
tools.description: Use when a trip includes a boat: Ha Long Bay cruises, Cat Ba, Cu Lao Cham (Hoi An), Ly Son, Con Dao or Phu Quoc. Returns official or operator notices that suspended sailing, with issuing authority, start and end time and source. With active_on it answers suspension_recorded or no_record for that day (never 'open'); without it, it returns the history so you can judge seasonal risk.

route.description: ha_long, cat_ba, cu_lao_cham, ly_son, con_dao, phu_quoc, or a place name

tools.name: weather_hazard_alerts
tools.description: Use when a trip to Vietnam starts within about a week, or the user is already there, and you need to know whether the national forecasting centre has issued storm, tropical depression, heavy rain, flood, flash flood, landslide or rough-sea bulletins. Returns the latest bulletin titles (verbatim, Vietnamese) with links, optionally filtered to those naming a province or place, plus how fresh the list is. It quotes official bulletins and does not forecast; if the list is stale it says the status is unknown.

province.description: Province or place, accents optional, e.g. "Quang Ninh", "Hue", "Ha Giang"

tools.name: vn_holiday_calendar
tools.description: Use when trip dates may overlap Tet (Lunar New Year) or another Vietnamese public holiday, when closures, price rises and sold-out transport are likely. Returns the officially announced holiday periods that overlap a date range, who they bind (public sector; private employers may differ), the notice number and source. Dates not yet announced are reported as unknown, not as holiday-free.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to one year after from

tools.name: official_evisa_domains
tools.description: Use when a user is about to apply or pay for a Vietnam e-visa, or asks whether a visa website is real. Returns the government e-visa domains with evidence, so look-alike agency sites can be told apart.

tools.name: motorbike_rules
tools.description: Use when a user plans to ride a motorbike or scooter in Vietnam (Ha Giang Loop, city rental) and asks about licences, International Driving Permits or fines. Returns the penalties under Decree 168/2024 Art. 18 for riding with no licence or with a foreign licence / 1968-Convention IDP but no national licence, with legal basis and source.

tools.name: quota_status
tools.description: Use when a trip includes an experience with a hard visitor cap, currently the Son Doong cave expedition. Returns the operator, annual quota, price, sold-out horizon and source.

tools.name: evisa_application_info
tools.description: Use when a user asks how a Vietnam e-visa application works: government fee, validity, processing time, or whether and how a stay can be extended. Returns source-linked facts per topic (evisa_fee, evisa_processing, evisa_validity, evisa_extension, extension_procedure, overstay_action) and marks topics where sources conflict instead of guessing.

topic.description: optional: fee, processing, validity, extension or overstay

tools.name: overstay_rules
tools.description: Use when a traveller may stay past their visa or visa-exemption end date, or asks what an overstay costs. Returns the fine band under Decree 282/2025/ND-CP for a given number of days overstayed (or all bands), the deportation caveat and what to do, with sources.

days.description: days overstayed, 1 to 3650; omit for all bands
